text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch fo their accuracy.
THAWRA
- The United States helps Zionist entity to commit aggression against Palestinians and Arabs
- Let's turn our wrath against Zionist aggression into a new pan-Arab intifada
- Stone-throwing Palestinians inflict terror in Zionist ranks
- Iraq lauds French stand on U.S. missile strikes on targets in southern Iraq
- Foreign minister reiterates Iraq's rejection of Turkey's plan on security cordon
- Foreign minister meets Yemeni counterpart
- The Arab nation marks today the 26th anniversary of the death of Gamal Abdel Nasser
- Yemen denounces Zionist massacres in occupied Palestine
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA, QADISSIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial attacks Israeli treatment of Palestinians and calls for tougher Arab stand against the Jewish state
JUMHOURIYA
- U.S. administration says it is not committed to preventing Iraq from spreading its control over its north
- Editorial blasts Arab rulers and U.S. and holds them accountable for the eruption of clashes in the West Bank and Gaza Strip
AL-IRAQ
- Stability returns to Iraqi Kurdistan
- Editorial tells Arab countries that they would be disappointed if they believed the present Israeli government would work for genuine peace
BABEL (Newspaper of President Saddam Hussein's eldest son Uday)
- Editorial warns Israel that Nebuchadnezzar and his troops, who dragged tens of thousands of Jews to captivity in Babylon in the sixth century B.C., would soon be back to liberate Jerusalem
